_about: V65CAM: keep BOTH fighters in the safe area of the lock-on camera (CamFraming.cs, called from CameraRig). Safe area = the viewport rectangle CameraRig.VisibleFraction tests, shrunk by marginX / marginY. The camera moves straight back along its view ray by the exact distance needed (max maxExtraDist m); what camera collision pulls back in is caught by opening the FOV up to fovMax (released at fovReleaseDegPerS). enabled=false = the V3 pose as before. proof = thresholds of the -camproof harness (CamProof.cs).
